enchantment.rajswordmod.reach.desc: Increases attack range of melee weapons.
enchantment.rajswordmod.backstabber.desc: Deal bonus damage when attacking the back of a mob. An indicator appears on screen when a backstab is available.
rajswordmod.hovertext.anti_armor_sword: §8Hold right click to charge forward with ramping speed. When the attack ends, hits enemies and applies a stacking armor debuff
rajswordmod.hovertext.deflect_sword_awak:
§6DEFLECT§r
§eHold right-click to enter a defensive stance, deflecting all nearby projectiles back.
Now Awakened, no ranger can match its fury, as every shot fired is turned against its master.
rajswordmod.hovertext.deflect_sword_unaw: One of the two legendary Guarding blades, renowned for centuries as the scourge of marksmen and archers alike.

§6REND§r
§eHold right-click to enter a defensive stance, slicing all nearby projectiles to pieces.
rajswordmod.tooltip.arrow_render_enchant: §5The blade yearns for a Sweeping Edge...
rajswordmod.hovertext.sentinel_sword_awa:
§6COUNTER§r
§eHold right-click to enter a defensive stance, storing all damage taken and releasing it as a destructive blast.
Now Awakened, its perfect defence becomes an unstoppable offence, releasing the full force of every blow it has endured as a single, devastating counter.
rajswordmod.hovertext.sentinel_sword_una: One of the two legendary Guarding blades, its wielder stands firm against the heaviest of blows.

§6GUARD§r
§eHold right-click to enter a defensive stance, becoming invulnerable and immovable briefly.
rajswordmod.hovertext.knockback_sword_aw:
§6MAXIMUM REPULSION§r
§eHold right-click to pull enemies into your range before unleashing a massive blast.
The Enchantments have restored all mystical functionality, now the blade can now launch with maximum efficiency.
rajswordmod.hovertext.knockback_sword_un: A mystical blade, empowered with the ability to shatter bones and send foes flying.

§6REPULSE§r
§eRight-click to charge a powerful blast that flings all enemies backward with immense force.
rajswordmod.hovertext.holy_sword_awakene:
§6RADIANCE§r
§eSlashing and killing undead can cause a holy explosion that burn enemies with holy fire. Undead killed while burining cause new explosions
With divine power once again coursing throughout, the salvation this blade brings is no longer limited.
rajswordmod.hovertext.holy_sword_unawake: Descended from the heavens, this divine sword purges the undead in a sea of holy flames.

§6REVERENCE§r
§eSlashing undead has a chance to create a holy explosion, burining undead in holy flames. Kills always cause explosions.
rajswordmod.tooltip.holy_enchant: §5The blade longs for more sacred power...
rajswordmod.hovertext.gaia_sword_awakene:
§6DESTRUCTO-SPIN§r
§eFull swings launch a disc of energy that pierces foes and returns to the wielder.
With its potential reached, its energy is now properly balanced and circulates in a perfect, lethal loop.
rajswordmod.hovertext.gaia_sword_unawake: A blade that vibrates with latent unstable energy, desperate to be unleashed.

§6SLASH§r
§eFull swings launch a slash of energy that hits pierces foes before dissipating.
rajswordmod.hovertext.blood_sword_awaken:
§6BLOOD FRENZY§r
§eAttacks store health from target as well as bonus damage. Hold right click to consume this health and detonate the stored damage.
Now awakened, this dark blade curses the wounds of its victims, allowing itself to tear them open at will.
rajswordmod.hovertext.blood_sword_unawak:
§6BLOOD SIPHON§r
§eAttacks with the sword store some health from the target. Hold right click to consume this health to heal.
A vampiric blade forged through forbidden rituals, endowed with an endless hunger for blood.
rajswordmod.hovertext.anti_armour_sword_:
§6STEALING STRIKE§r
§eRight click to charge up a powerful thrust. When released lunge forward and steal an enemy's armour for yourself momentarily.
Now awakened, this weapon's true power is unleashed, allowing it to plunder the defence it so easily destroys.

§6PIERCING STRIKE§r
§eRight click to charge up a powerful thrust. When released, lunge forward and apply a stacking armour debuff to the target.
A vicious blade which can pierce through even the toughest of armour, leaving its wearer weak and vulnerable.
rajswordmod.hovertext.shadow_clone_sword:
§6LIVING SHADOW§r
§eRight click to summon a living clone of yourself which takes all nearby enemy aggro and fights back. Gain invisibility while the clone is alive.
Now awakened, the dark shadow imbued inside the blade is fully unleashed, allowing its malice to once again harm the living.

§6SHADOW CLONE§r
§eRight click to summon a clone of yourself which takes all nearby enemy aggro. Gain invisibility while the clone is active.
A black blade forged by dark powers, imbued with the power to deceive even the keenest of eyes.,
